_metadata.title: Assam Agricultural University (AAU) Aligned Crop Database

recommended_varieties: Submergence tolerant (Flood prone): Ranjit Sub-1, Bahadur Sub-1, Swarna Sub-1

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply all SSP, all MOP, and 50% Urea at final puddling (basal). Apply 25% Urea at tillering (20-25 days after transplanting) and 25% Urea at panicle initiation (40-45 DAT).
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azospirillum or PSB slurry dip for seedlings before transplanting.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 4-5 times followed by thorough puddling and leveling. Maintain 2-3 cm standing water during puddling to seal pores and reduce percolation.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Treat seeds with Carbendazim 2g/kg seed. Raise wet-bed nursery in June. Transplant 25-30 day old seedlings at 20x15 cm spacing with 2-3 seedlings per hill.
necessary_steps.water_management: Maintain 2-5 cm shallow standing water till grain hardening. Drain completely 7-10 days before harvest.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Watch for Rice Hispa (apply Chlorpyriphos 20 EC if >1 adult/hill), Stem Borer, and Bacterial Leaf Blight. Keep bunds weed-free.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest when 80-85% grains turn golden yellow. Sun-dry paddy to 12-14% moisture before storage in bamboo dhol or airtight bins.

major_pests.name: Rice Hispa (Dicladispa armigera)
major_pests.symptoms: Adults scrape upper surface of leaf blade causing characteristic white parallel streaks; grubs mine inside leaves.
major_pests.etl: 1 adult or 1 damaged leaf per hill
major_pests.biological: Clip seedling tips before transplanting to destroy hispa eggs. Spray Neem oil (Azadirachtin 1500 ppm) @ 3 ml/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 2.5 ml/L or Quinalphos 25 EC @ 2 ml/L upon reaching ETL.

major_pests.name: Yellow Stem Borer (Scirpophaga incertulas)
major_pests.symptoms: Dead hearts during vegetative stage; white ears (empty panicles) during reproductive stage.
major_pests.biological: Release Trichogramma japonicum egg parasitoid @ 20,000/bigha 3-4 times at weekly intervals. Install pheromone traps @ 3 traps/bigha.
major_pests.chemical: Cartap hydrochloride 4G @ 3.3 kg/bigha or spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Rice Blast (Pyricularia oryzae)
major_diseases.symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with brown borders and grey centers on leaves; black necrotic lesions at panicle neck node causing neck blast.
major_diseases.management: Treat seeds with Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 2g/kg seed. Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L or Kasugamycin @ 1.5 ml/L at boot-leaf stage.

major_diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight (Xanthomonas oryzae)
major_diseases.symptoms: Wavy, yellowish-white lesions starting from leaf tips and margins; 'Kresek' wilt in young seedlings.
major_diseases.management: Avoid excess Urea application; apply split potash. Spray Streptocycline @ 0.15 g/L mixed with Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L.

recommended_varieties: Direct-seeded upland: Govind, Vandana, Luit, Disang, Kapilee

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply full SSP, full MOP, and 50% Urea at final land prep. Top dress 25% Urea after first weeding (20 days) and 25% at panicle emergence.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azotobacter and PSB seed treatment (20g each per kg seed).

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 3-4 times immediately after pre-monsoon showers in March to bring soil to fine tilth. Level to prevent water stagnation.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Line sow seeds at 20 cm row-to-row spacing (75-80 kg/ha) or broadcast (85-100 kg/ha). Seed depth 2-3 cm.
necessary_steps.water_management: Critical stages needing moisture: tillering and flowering. Provide life-saving drainage if heavy pre-monsoon rains flood the field.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Control weeds aggressively at 15-20 and 35-40 days. Scout for blast and brown plant hopper.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest early before peak monsoon floods submerge the crop in late June/July.

major_pests.name: Stem Borer & Leaf Roller
major_pests.symptoms: Dead hearts and folded leaves with scraping.
major_pests.biological: Install bird perches @ 5/bigha; pheromone traps @ 2/bigha.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Flubendiamide 39.35 SC @ 0.25 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Blast & Brown Spot
major_diseases.symptoms: Brown oval spots on leaves during early monsoon showers.
major_diseases.management: Seed treatment with Carbendazim 2g/kg. Spray Mancozeb @ 2 g/L.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply full SSP, full MOP, and 33% Urea at puddling. 33% Urea at active tillering (30 DAT), 33% at panicle initiation (50 DAT).
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azospirillum and PSB root seedling dip.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Grow in low-lying waterlogged beel areas, char lands, or irrigated pockets. Thorough puddling in December/January.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Protect winter nursery with polythene covering at night to combat severe December cold/fog. Transplant 35-45 day old seedlings.
necessary_steps.water_management: Requires assured shallow tubewell (STW) or river lift irrigation. Keep saturated soil to 3-5 cm water depth.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Watch out for cold injury at nursery, followed by blast and sheath blight during March warming.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest quickly in April before pre-monsoon flash floods arrive in low-lying basins.

major_pests.name: Brown Planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens)
major_pests.symptoms: 'Hopper burn' circular drying patches in dense boro canopy in March-April.
major_pests.biological: Alternate wetting and drying (AWD); avoid excessive dense planting.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Pymetrozine 50 WDG @ 0.6 g/L or Dinotefuran 20 SG @ 0.4 g/L towards base of hills.

major_diseases.name: Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani)
major_diseases.symptoms: Snake-skin like greenish-grey lesions on leaf sheaths just above water line.
major_diseases.management: Spray Validamycin 3L @ 2 ml/L or Hexaconazole 5 EC @ 2 ml/L.

crops.season_as: বাৰমহীয়া (মুখ্য পাত চয়ন: চ’তৰ পৰা আঘোণ)
recommended_varieties: Tocklai Clones: TV-1, TV-9, TV-18, TV-20, TV-22, TV-23, TV-25, TV-26

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply NPK mixture in 2-3 split applications: first in March-April after first showers, second in May-June, third in August-September.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Mycorrhiza (VAM) and Trichoderma bio-formulations during planting and mulch.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Upland topography with gentle slope (1-2%). Deep soil digging (45-60 cm). Heavy drainage trenches (90 cm deep x 60 cm wide) every 10-15 rows are MANDATORY to prevent root rot.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Plant 1-year-old bicolonal or clonal plants in pit size 45x45x45 cm with compost and SSP. Plant shade trees (Albizia odoratissima) at 12x12 m spacing.
necessary_steps.water_management: Never allow standing water—waterlogging for >48 hours severely damages tea feeder roots. Mulch in winter.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Control Tea Mosquito Bug (Helopeltis) and Red Spider Mite using AAU/TRA recommended IPM. Monitor during flush cycles.
necessary_steps.harvest: Pluck 'two leaves and a bud' every 7-8 days during active flushing for premium CTC/Orthodox quality.

major_pests.name: Tea Mosquito Bug (Helopeltis theivora)
major_pests.symptoms: Circular brown necrosis spots on succulent young flushing buds; severe curling and drying of shoots.
major_pests.biological: Keep shade regulated and weed-free. Spray Beauveria bassiana @ 5 g/L during early morning/evening.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.25 g/L or Clothianidin 50 WDG @ 0.16 g/L strictly adhering to Tocklai CIBRC guidelines.

major_pests.name: Red Spider Mite (Oligonychus coffeae)
major_pests.symptoms: Rusty bronze coloration of mature leaves; webs on upper leaf surface during dry warm spells.
major_pests.biological: Wash bushes with high-pressure water jet; spray Wettable Sulphur 80 WP @ 2.5 g/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Spiromesifen 22.9 SC @ 1 ml/L or Fenpyroximate 5 EC @ 1 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Black Rot (Corticium theae)
major_diseases.symptoms: Leaves turn black, rot, and remain suspended by mycelial cords inside bush canopy during rainy months.
major_diseases.management: Thin out dense bush center for sunlight penetration. Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 2.5 g/L.

crops.season_en: Rabi: Mid Oct - Nov sowing, Feb - Mar harvest

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply 100% SSP, 100% MOP, and 50% Urea at final land preparation. Top dress remaining 50% Urea 25-30 days after sowing before first irrigation.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azotobacter and PSB seed coating.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 4-6 times immediately after Sali rice harvest to catch residual moisture. Cultivate to fine, firm, moisture-retentive seedbed.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Sow in lines at 30 cm spacing, 2-3 cm depth. Seed rate: 10-12 kg/ha (1.5 kg/bigha). Thinning at 10-15 DAS to keep 10 cm plant-to-plant.
necessary_steps.water_management: Provide 1-2 irrigations: first at flowering stage (30 DAS) and second at pod formation (55 DAS) if winter rains fail.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Watch out for Mustard Aphids (মোৱা পোক). If aphid colony appears on top 10 cm twigs, spray Dimethoate 30 EC or neem oil 1500 ppm.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest in morning hours when siliquae turn golden-yellow to avoid shattering. Dry seeds in sun for 4-5 days.

major_pests.name: Mustard Aphid (Lipaphis erysimi)
major_pests.symptoms: Swarms of tiny yellow-green nymphs and adults sucking sap from inflorescence and tender siliqua, causing curling and stunting.
major_pests.etl: 20-25% aphid infestation on terminal 10 cm shoot
major_pests.biological: Sow early (by Oct 25 - Nov 5) to escape aphid build-up. Install yellow sticky traps @ 5/bigha.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1.5 ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.3 ml/L late in afternoon to protect honeybee pollinators.

major_diseases.name: Alternaria Blight (Alternaria brassicae)
major_diseases.symptoms: Concentric target-board circular black spots on leaves and siliquae.
major_diseases.management: Seed treatment with Mancozeb @ 3g/kg. Spray Iprodione 50 WP @ 2 g/L or Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply full FYM, full SSP, full MOP, and 50% Urea in furrows at planting. Top dress remaining 50% Urea at earthing up (30 DAP).
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azotobacter and PSB tuber treatment.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Loose, friable, well-aerated sandy loam soil. Deep ploughing to 25 cm followed by thorough clod crushing.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Use sprouted, certified disease-free whole seed tubers (35-45g). Plant on ridges at 50-60 cm row spacing and 15-20 cm tuber spacing.
necessary_steps.water_management: Critical stages for irrigation: stolon formation, tuber initiation, and tuber sizing. Never submerge the ridge.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Late blight is the #1 killer in Assam's winter fog. Spray Mancozeb 75 WP prophylactically at canopy closure.
necessary_steps.harvest: Cut haulms (foliage) 10-12 days before digging to cure tuber skin. Dig carefully without cutting tubers.

major_pests.name: Cutworm (Agrotis ipsilon)
major_pests.symptoms: Larvae cut tender seedlings at ground level during night; hide in soil during day.
major_pests.biological: Flood fields lightly before earthing up; use light traps.
major_pests.chemical: Drench soil around plants with Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 3 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)
major_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on leaves turning black rapidly in cloudy, humid, foggy winter mornings; white mold under leaf surface.
major_diseases.management: Prophylactic spray of Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L before foggy spells. Upon symptom appearance, spray Cymoxanil + Mancozeb (Curzate) @ 2.5 g/L or Metalaxyl-M + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L.

crops.season_en: Pre-Kharif to Kharif: Mar-May sowing, Jul-Sep harvest
recommended_varieties: Olitorius (Tossa Jute): JRO-524 (Navin), JRO-7835, JRO-632, Tarun

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply full SSP and MOP at final land preparation. Apply Urea in two splits: 50% at 3 weeks and 50% at 6 weeks after sowing.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azospirillum and PSB seed inoculation.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 4-5 times in March-April to obtain fine tilth. Ensure good drainage for Capsularis and well-drained loam for Olitorius.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Line sowing at 25-30 cm row spacing. Seed rate: 6-7 kg/ha for capsularis, 4-5 kg/ha for olitorius.
necessary_steps.water_management: Tolerates water stagnation after 2 months of growth; excellent crop for low-lying flood-prone belts.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Watch out for Jute Semilooper, Hairy Caterpillar, and stem rot.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest at 50% flowering stage (100-120 days) for best fiber tensile strength. Ret in clean, slow-moving water with Ribbon retting or microbial consortium.

major_pests.name: Jute Semilooper (Anomis sabulifera)
major_pests.symptoms: Green caterpillars feed voraciously on apical buds and tender leaves, retarding shoot elongation.
major_pests.biological: Spray Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) @ 2 g/L; erect bamboo perches for insectivorous birds.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Lambda-cyhalothrin 5 EC @ 1 ml/L or Profenofos 50 EC @ 2 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Stem Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina)
major_diseases.symptoms: Dark brown necrotic lesions on stem leading to shredding and plant lodging.
major_diseases.management: Avoid waterlogging; treat seeds with Carbendazim 2g/kg. Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Per mature tree per year: Apply 15 kg FYM, 300g Urea, 400g SSP, 250g MOP in two equal splits (Feb-Mar and Aug-Sep).
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Trichoderma viride in pit; mycorrhiza for feeder roots.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Select high land free from water stagnation. Dig 60x60x60 cm pits at 3x3 m or 3.5x3.5 m spacing.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Use stem cuttings or air-layered plants from certified mother nurseries. Plant in April-May or Aug-Sep.
necessary_steps.water_management: Provide ring basin irrigation during dry winter (Nov-Feb). Strictly avoid waterlogging at root zone.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Citrus Canker is the biggest issue in Assam's wet climate: prune diseased twigs and spray Streptocycline (1g/10L) + Copper Oxychloride. Control Citrus Leaf Miner.
necessary_steps.harvest: Pick fully mature, dark-green to pale-yellow aromatic fruits with rich juice vesicles.

major_pests.name: Citrus Leaf Miner (Phyllocnistis citrella)
major_pests.symptoms: Silvery serpentine mines inside young tender flush; leaves become twisted and distorted.
major_pests.biological: Prune infested twigs during winter; spray Neem oil @ 4 ml/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Thiamethoxam 25 WG @ 0.3 g/L or Imidacloprid 17.8 SL @ 0.35 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Citrus Canker (Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. citri)
major_diseases.symptoms: Raised, corky, crater-like lesions with yellow halo on leaves, twigs, and lemon rinds.
major_diseases.management: Prune and burn cankered twigs before spring flush. Spray Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L mixed with Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L.

crops.season_en: Kharif to Rabi: Oct-Nov or Feb-Mar planting
recommended_varieties: Local ecotypes (Golaghat, Jorhat, Tezpur, Nagaland border)

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply full FYM, SSP, and MOP as basal. Apply Urea in 3 equal splits: 30, 60, and 90 days after transplanting.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Trichoderma harzianum soil treatment; Azospirillum.

necessary_steps.land_prep: High land with excellent natural drainage. Raised beds (15 cm high) are necessary to combat Assam monsoon downpours.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Raise seedlings in raised nursery beds or seedling trays. Transplant 30-40 day seedlings at 75x75 cm spacing. Provide light shade if possible.
necessary_steps.water_management: Very sensitive to root rot and collar rot from stagnant water. Use furrow irrigation or drip.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Prone to Anthracnose (fruit rot), Bacterial Wilt, and Aphid-transmitted leaf curl virus. Apply Bordeaux mixture or COC prophylactically.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest ripe red pods with pedicel intact. Wear rubber gloves when handling!

major_pests.name: Thrips & Whiteflies (Vector for Leaf Curl Virus)
major_pests.symptoms: Upward curling and crinkling of leaves, severe stunting; flower and fruit drop.
major_pests.biological: Yellow sticky traps @ 8/bigha; spray Neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%) @ 50 ml/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Diafenthiuron 50 WP @ 1.2 g/L or Fipronil 5 SC @ 1.5 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Anthracnose / Dieback & Fruit Rot (Colletotrichum capsici)
major_diseases.symptoms: Drying of twigs from top downwards; circular sunken brown lesions on ripe chilli pods.
major_diseases.management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 5g/kg. Spray Azoxystrobin 23 SC @ 1 ml/L or Difenoconazole 25 EC @ 0.8 ml/L.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Basal: full FYM, full SSP, 50% MOP. Top dress Urea in 2 splits (45 and 90 DAP) with earthing up.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Trichoderma viride enriched FYM (20g/kg FYM) is essential to stop rhizome rot.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Well-drained rich sandy loam. Make raised beds 15 cm high, 1 m wide, with 30-40 cm wide drainage channels between beds.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Treat healthy seed rhizomes (25-30g, 2-3 live buds) in Mancozeb (3g/L) for 30 minutes. Plant at 25x20 cm spacing, 4-5 cm deep.
necessary_steps.water_management: Mulch immediately after planting with green leaves (10-12 t/ha) to conserve moisture and suppress weeds.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Rhizome Rot (Pythium) and Shoot Borer are major threats. Drench beds with Copper Oxychloride or Trichoderma if rot starts.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest after 8-9 months when leaves turn completely yellow and dry. Cure rhizomes in shade.

major_pests.name: Shoot Borer (Conogethes punctiferalis)
major_pests.symptoms: Larvae bore into pseudostems; central shoot withers into 'dead heart'.
major_pests.biological: Cut and destroy dead shoots; spray Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2 g/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 ml/L or Chlorantraniliprole @ 0.3 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Rhizome Rot / Soft Rot (Pythium aphanidermatum)
major_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked rot at base of pseudostem; foul decaying odor; whole clump turns yellow and pulls out easily.
major_diseases.management: Strict raised-bed drainage! Treat seed rhizomes with Metalaxyl + Mancozeb (Ridomil Gold) @ 2.5 g/L for 30 minutes before planting. Drench soil around affected clumps.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply full FYM and SSP at planting. Urea and MOP applied in two equal splits at 45 and 90 DAP along with earthing up.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Trichoderma enriched compost; Azotobacter.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Deep ploughing (20-25 cm) to produce loose, friable bed. Make raised beds 15 cm high and 1 m wide.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Plant whole mother rhizomes or primary fingers (20-25g) at 30x20 cm spacing, 4 cm depth. Cover with fine soil.
necessary_steps.water_management: Apply heavy green leaf mulch (12 t/ha) at planting and again at 45 days. Ensure zero water stagnation.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Leaf blotch (Taphrina) and Rhizome scale. Spray Mancozeb if leaf spots appear.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest at 9 months when foliage dries completely. Boil rhizomes in water for 45-60 mins and sun dry for 10-15 days.

major_pests.name: Shoot Borer & Leaf Roller
major_pests.symptoms: Holes in pseudostem with frass; folded leaves.
major_pests.biological: Install light traps; spray Neem oil @ 3 ml/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Flubendiamide 39.35 SC @ 0.25 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Leaf Spot (Colletotrichum capsici) & Taphrina Blotch
major_diseases.symptoms: Brown elliptic spots on upper surface of leaves that coalesce rapidly.
major_diseases.management: Spray Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5 g/L or Propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L.

crops.season_en: Late Kharif: Aug-Sep sowing, Nov-Dec harvest

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: As a nitrogen-fixing legume, apply all fertilizers (starter N, full SSP, and MOP) as basal in furrows before sowing.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Rhizobium leguminosarum and PSB seed inoculation (50g/kg seed).

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 2-3 times to achieve moderate tilth. Often grown as a relay crop in standing rice or after Ahu rice harvest.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Treat seeds with Rhizobium culture. Line sow at 30 cm row spacing with 10 cm plant spacing (20-25 kg/ha).
necessary_steps.water_management: Generally rainfed; sensitive to waterlogging. Provide drainage furrows every 3-4 meters.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Yellow Mosaic Virus transmitted by whitefly is the most serious disease. Spray Imidacloprid if whiteflies appear.
necessary_steps.harvest: Pick mature black pods in 2-3 pickings or uproot entire plant when 80% pods turn black. Dry and thresh.

major_pests.name: Pod Borer Complex (Maruca vitrata)
major_pests.symptoms: Larvae web together flowers and pods; bore holes into developing pods.
major_pests.biological: Spray NSKE 5% at flowering; install pheromone traps @ 3/bigha.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 ml/L or Emamectin Benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L.

major_diseases.name: Yellow Mosaic Virus (MYMV)
major_diseases.symptoms: Bright yellow patches interspersed with green on leaf lamina; vector is Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci).
major_diseases.management: Grow tolerant varieties (Pratap, Pant U-19). Spray Acetamiprid 20 SP @ 0.25 g/L to control whiteflies.

crops.name_en: Assam Joha Rice (Aromatic Scented Rice - GI Tagged)
crops.name_as: জোহা ধান (সুগন্ধি ধান - জি আই স্বীকৃত)

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply all SSP, MOP and 50% Urea at puddling. Low chemical nitrogen is mandatory to preserve authentic aroma and avoid lodging.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azospirillum & PSB seedling root dip.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Puddle 3-4 times thoroughly. Joha requires good organic base; incorporate green manure (Dhaincha) or FYM.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Transplant 25-30 day seedlings at 20x15 cm spacing (2-3 seedlings/hill).
necessary_steps.water_management: Maintain shallow 2-3 cm water. Avoid deep flooding.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Scout for Yellow Stem Borer and Neck Blast. Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L at early heading if neck blast appears.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest as soon as 80% grains are yellow. Over-drying or delaying harvest reduces aroma.

major_pests.name: Stem Borer & Leaf Folder
major_pests.symptoms: Dead hearts; longitudinal folding of leaves.
major_pests.biological: Pheromone traps @ 2/bigha; release Trichogramma japonicum.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Neck Blast
major_diseases.symptoms: Lesions at panicle node leading to unfilled chaffy grains.
major_diseases.management: Spray Tricyclazole 75 WP @ 0.6 g/L.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Per pit (plant): FYM 10kg + Neem cake 500g at planting. Split Urea and MOP into 4 applications: 3rd, 5th, 7th and 9th month after planting.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: AM fungi (VAM) 50g and Azospirillum 50g per pit.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Dig pits of 50x50x50 cm at 2x2 m spacing (approx 330 plants/bigha). Fill with topsoil + FYM.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Use sword suckers (weight 1.5 - 2.0 kg) or tissue-cultured plantlets. Pare sucker corms and dip in Carbendazim 2g/L.
necessary_steps.water_management: Provide irrigation during dry winter months (every 10-14 days). Provide drainage trenches to prevent waterlogging.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Desucker regularly leaving only 1 follower. Propping with bamboo stakes during bunch emergence.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest bunch when fingers are plump and angles become round (approx 90-110 days after flowering).

major_pests.name: Banana Rhizome Weevil (Cosmopolites sordidus)
major_pests.symptoms: Grubs tunnel inside corm; plant turns pale, yellow, and topples over in wind.
major_pests.biological: Use disc-on-stump pheromone traps; clean planting suckers thoroughly.
major_pests.chemical: Apply Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 2.5 ml/L drenching around base.

major_diseases.name: Panama Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. cubense)
major_diseases.symptoms: Yellowing of lower leaf margins spreading upward; petiole buckling; vascular discoloration in pseudostem.
major_diseases.management: Grow resistant varieties (Cavendish/Jahaji); avoid water stagnation; apply Trichoderma viride enriched FYM @ 2 kg/pit.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Per bearing palm: 100g N, 40g P2O5, 140g K2O + 12kg FYM annually. Apply in 2 splits: 1/3rd in April-May (pre-monsoon) and 2/3rd in Sept-Oct (post-monsoon).
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azospirillum and Phosphobacteria 25g each per palm.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plant in homestead bari or orchard at 2.7 x 2.7 m spacing (approx 180 palms/bigha). Dig pits of 60x60x60 cm.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Select 1-2 year old vigorous seedlings with 4-5 healthy leaves from mother palms with heavy bunches.
necessary_steps.water_management: Provide organic mulch (paddy straw, arecanut leaves) in basin to conserve moisture in dry winter.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Intercrop with Black Pepper, Banana, and Ginger for maximum multi-tier farm income.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest mature green nuts for fermentation (Bura Tamul) or ripe orange nuts for drying (Supari).

major_pests.name: Spindle Bug (Carvalhoia arecae)
major_pests.symptoms: Nymphs and adults suck sap from tender unopened spindle leaves; necrotic streaks appear.
major_pests.biological: Place phorate or neem seed cake in crown crevices.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1.5 ml/L into spindle base.

major_diseases.name: Koleroga / Mahali (Fruit Rot - Phytophthora arecae)
major_diseases.symptoms: Water-soaked lesions on nuts causing extensive premature nut fall during heavy July-August rains.
major_diseases.management: Prophylactic spray of 1% Bordeaux mixture or Copper Oxychloride @ 3 g/L before onset of monsoon; repeat 40 days later.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Per standard vine: 100g N, 40g P2O5, 140g K2O annually in two splits (May-June and August-September). Apply 10 kg FYM per vine.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Trichoderma viride in FYM basin.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plant rooted cuttings at north or north-east side of arecanut tree trunk at 30 cm distance.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Tie vine gently with banana pseudostem fiber as it grows up the tree trunk.
necessary_steps.water_management: Ensure adequate shade and organic mulching at the root zone.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Prune side runners; prevent water logging around the base.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest spikes when 1 or 2 berries on the spike turn bright orange-red. Sun dry berries on mats for 7-10 days.

major_pests.name: Pollu Beetle (Longitarsus nigripennis)
major_pests.symptoms: Grubs bore into tender pepper berries and feed on internal seeds, leaving empty hollow shells.
major_pests.biological: Regulate overhead shade; spray Quassia extract.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Quinalphos 25 EC @ 2 ml/L in July and October.

major_diseases.name: Quick Wilt / Foot Rot (Phytophthora capsici)
major_diseases.symptoms: Sudden wilting of whole vine within 2-3 weeks; black rot at collar region with water-soaked lesions.
major_diseases.management: Drench basin with 0.2% Copper Oxychloride or Metalaxyl-Mancozeb @ 2 g/L before and after monsoon; incorporate Trichoderma.

crops.season_en: Kharif: Jul-Aug sowing; Rabi: Feb-Mar sowing

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply 50% N and all P and K as basal dose. Top dress remaining 50% N at 30 days after sowing.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Seed treatment with Azotobacter.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 3 times to get fine tilth; level field properly to ensure no waterlogging.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Seed rate 600-700 g/bigha. Mix seed with dry sand (1:4) for uniform broadcasting or line sow at 30x10 cm.
necessary_steps.water_management: Highly sensitive to waterlogging. Provide drainage furrows every 3 meters.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Thinning at 15-20 days after emergence is critical for good pod branching.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest when bottom capsules turn yellowish-green and leaves begin to drop.

major_pests.name: Til Hawk Moth & Leaf Roller
major_pests.symptoms: Larvae web top leaves together and defoliate plant.
major_pests.biological: Handpick large caterpillars; spray Neem oil @ 3 ml/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Chlorpyriphos 20 EC @ 2 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Phyllody (Mycoplasma transmitted by Jassids)
major_diseases.symptoms: Floral parts turn into green leafy structures; complete sterility.
major_diseases.management: Rogue out infected plants immediately; spray Imidacloprid @ 0.3 ml/L to control vector.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Entire fertilizer applied as basal dose at final land preparation.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Rhizobium leguminosarum and PSB seed inoculation (50g/bigha seed).

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 2-3 times after Sali paddy harvest to conserve residual moisture.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Can be broadcast as relay crop (Utera/Pyra) in standing Sali rice 10-15 days before harvest.
necessary_steps.water_management: Usually grown on residual soil moisture; one light irrigation at pod filling stage if winter is completely dry.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Keep early weeds checked by one hand weeding at 25-30 days.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest when pods turn golden brown and rattle when shaken.

major_pests.name: Aphids & Pod Borer
major_pests.symptoms: Sap sucking on flowers and pods causing poor seed set.
major_pests.biological: Yellow sticky traps; spray NSKE 5%.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Dimethoate 30 EC @ 1.5 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Lentil Wilt (Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lentis)
major_diseases.symptoms: Drooping and yellowing of foliage; vascular discoloration in root.
major_diseases.management: Seed treatment with Trichoderma viride @ 4g/kg seed; crop rotation.

recommended_varieties: Cabbage: Golden Acre, Pride of India, Pusa Mukta
Cauliflower: Pusa Deepali (early), Improved Japanese, Snowball-16 (late)

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply 50% Urea and all SSP & MOP as basal. Top dress 25% Urea at 30 days and 25% at 45 days after transplanting.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Azospirillum and PSB root dip.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Plough 4-5 times to fine tilth. Incorporate 2 tonnes FYM per bigha. Apply 2 kg Borax/bigha to prevent cauliflower browning.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Transplant 25-day seedlings at 60x45 cm spacing on ridges.
necessary_steps.water_management: Irrigate at 8-10 day intervals. Avoid flood stagnation.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Earth up 30 days after planting. Blanch cauliflower heads by covering curds with leaves 4-5 days before harvest.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest firm, compact heads/curds before they become loose or discolored.

major_pests.name: Diamondback Moth - DBM (Plutella xylostella)
major_pests.symptoms: Larvae feed on under surface of leaves leaving parchment-like transparent windows; severe defoliation.
major_pests.biological: Grow mustard trap crop every 25 rows; spray Bacillus thuringiensis @ 2 g/L or Spinosad 45 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.
major_pests.chemical: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5 SC @ 0.3 ml/L.

major_diseases.name: Black Rot (Xanthomonas campestris)
major_diseases.symptoms: V-shaped chlorotic lesions with black veins starting from leaf margins.
major_diseases.management: Hot water seed treatment at 50°C for 30 mins; spray Copper Oxychloride @ 2.5 g/L with Streptocycline @ 0.1 g/L.

fertilizer_aau.split_schedule: Apply all SSP, 50% MOP and 30% Urea as basal. Remaining Urea in 3 splits during active vegetative and fruiting periods.
fertilizer_aau.biofertilizers: Trichoderma enriched manure.

necessary_steps.land_prep: Well-drained sandy loam or silt loam soils (ideal for river bank char lands). Make pits at 2x2 m.
necessary_steps.seed_and_sowing: Propagate vegetative root cuttings or vine cuttings. Maintain 1 male plant for every 9 female plants for pollination.
necessary_steps.water_management: Irrigate during dry months of Feb-April. Provide trellis or bamboo bower (chapor) for vines.
necessary_steps.pest_disease: Hand-pollination in early morning substantially increases fruit set and size.
necessary_steps.harvest: Harvest tender green fruits every 3-4 days before seeds harden.

major_pests.name: Fruit Fly (Bactrocera cucurbitae)
major_pests.symptoms: Maggots feed inside fruits causing rot and premature fruit fall.
major_pests.biological: Install cue-lure pheromone traps @ 3/bigha; collect and bury damaged fruits.
major_pests.chemical: Bait spray with Malathion 50 EC @ 2 ml + 10g jaggery/L.

major_diseases.name: Downy Mildew & Root Rot
major_diseases.symptoms: Angular yellow patches on upper leaf surface; water-soaked vine rot.
major_diseases.management: Spray Metalaxyl + Mancozeb @ 2 g/L.
